Create one YOLO-format .txt file per manually annotated image in this folder.

Format per line:
class_id center_x center_y width height

Coordinates must be normalized to [0, 1]. Use class_id 0 for Graphite Nodule.
Recommended initial evaluation set: the five difficult images named in the project task,
plus 5-15 additional images covering clean, large, small, irregular, textured,
low-contrast, merged, and edge-adjacent nodules.

No automatic or synthetic ground truth is generated by this project.
